processInspection.method: Read-only Win32_Process snapshot for recorded child PID or chrome.exe command line containing exact isolated profile. Inspection shell excluded.
processInspection.finding: No recorded child PID or Chrome process matching the isolated profile remains. PID alone is not ownership proof because PIDs can be reused. No processes were terminated by this analysis.

memoryBoundary: nvidia-smi memoryUsedMiB is sampled device-wide driver-visible allocation including desktop/unrelated applications, both retained rendering backends, browser allocation/cache and diagnostic observer resources. Stage capture allocates transient texture-readback staging buffers and replay post/depth targets. This is not renderer-owned descriptor bytes, a source-isolated production peak, a production delta or leak evidence. Returned arrays/PNG encoding also consume separate CPU memory.
performanceBoundary: Elapsed seconds and telemetry are host observations only, not GPU queue/command times or the required eight-scene300+600x3 performance campaign. Successful diagnostic execution does not establish visual correctness or release acceptance.
